text: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program cultivate students to be professionals in Business Administration. To train international students with high moral, good health, good knowledge and innovative spirit. Be able to engage in various fields of marketing, marketing management, senior international corporate marketing and global marketing. 2. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program aims to cultivate students to be professionals in this field. Have a good knowledge of Chinese culture, politics, economy and history. Understanding Chinese language, including in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation proficiently. To master the necessary computer skills. Have the ability of the basic theory of economics, business management, marketing and international business, the basic knowledge and skills. To master certain analytical ability, creativity and decision-making ability. 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: Each student must complete 54 credits of courses including 36 compulsory, 18 elective and 8 for a practicum requirement. Compulsory courses Credits Elective Courses Credits Principles of Management 3 Consumer Behavior 2 Principles of Marketing 3 Service Marketing 2 Introduction to Financial Accounting 3 Marketing Channels 2 Corporate Finance 3 Business to Business Marketing 2 Organizational Behavior 3 Advertising and Promotion 2 Business Research 3 Management Accounting 2 Strategic Management 2 Financial Statement Analysis 2 Transnational Management 2 Investment Analysis 2 Cross-cultural Management 2 Intermediate Microeconomics 3 Operation Management 2 Chinese Business Law 2 Human Resources Management 2 International Trade Practice 3 Leadership 2 International Finance 2 Global Marketing 2 International Business Environment 2 International Corporate Finance 2 Data Model and Decision Making 2 4. Academic Semesters Editor Notes: There are 3 semesters in one academic year: fall, spring and summer. Fall and spring semesters consist of 14 weeks of normal classes and a summer term consists of 8 weeks of classes (except Practicum and Internship). Fall Semester: the beginning of September to next January Spring Semester: the beginning of March to the beginning of July Summer Vacation: the beginning of July to the end of August Time Registration Time of Spring Semester : February 27-March 2 Beginning Time of Spring Semester: March 5 Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package. 5. Thesis Editor Notes: In the fourth year of their study, students must complete a thesis related to their major to meet the graduation requirements. ​ The thesis should consists of about 8000 words. The thesis shall be an assessment on the intended level of achievement both in the major and the general learning outcomes by the students. Students should apply their learning to complex, unscripted problems in the context of their advanced studies, the mastery of the skills. Students should use the ability to integrate knowledge and skills and present their work in an appropriate manner.​ 6. Internship and Career Development Editor Notes: The program will cultivate students with professional skills to function effectively and competitively in social and global environment. The university participates actively in promoting business and economic cooperation between China and other countries. Students have the opportunities to do a part-time job or internship at the multinational or other big companies with various fields. Students can search on school website to find a good job, as lots of companies post their recruitment advertisement on the website. Students can either stay in China or return to their own countries to work for the company who have trade with China. Students can work in the sales of products or services and management, such as sales representatives, sales managers, sales consultants. Students can be suitable in circulation enterprises, production-oriented enterprises, the service sector and other industries engaged in marketing, research, planning or other management. 7. School introduction Editor Notes: UIBE is one of the important stations for talents' training and scientific research on Chinese economic and business development. ​ The University of International Business and Economics (UIBE) , situated in the northeast of Beijing, was founded in 1951. UIBE is a national key university under the leadership of the Ministry of Education, and is also a part of "Project 211", a governmental program aimed at turning about 100 Chinese universities into exceptionally high quality academic institutions in the 21st century , Learn More>> 8. Business School Editor Notes: The School pays much attention to the systematic integration of business management subjects. The University has established exchange projects with over 100 universities and institutes from more than 30 countries and regions around the world.​ ​ The School offers many opportunities to gain practical professional experience and understanding of Chinese culture & language. The School focuses on training business management talents with an international strategic vision. There are over 41 professional teachers and part-time teachers in this major. The School has rich teaching experience, professional high-quality, high academic qualification and reasonable structure. 9. Faculty Editor Notes: Two professors will be introduced specifically. Fan Libo, Associate Dean of Business School; Professor of Management; PhD; PhD Supervisor Research area : cross-national Management & Operation, Strategic Management, Innovation and Corporate Theory. Teaching area: (bachelor) principles of management, international business management, research methods and thesis writing; (master, including MBA) teaching management theory, strategic management, mergers and acquisitions and restructuring; (doctor) management theory.
